name: DriveMe
tagline: Premium chauffeur rides in Uzbekistan — a rider app and a driver app on one platform
role: Rider and driver apps for a premium chauffeur service

scenes.title: Rider app: book a chauffeur
scenes.body: Set the route on the map, pick a car class, then follow the assigned driver live.

scenes.title: The route sets the fare
scenes.body: Yandex routing on Google Maps measures the trip; a backup provider takes over if Yandex is down.

scenes.title: Business, Premium or Minivan
scenes.body: Each class shows its fare with the service fee included. Pay by cash, Uzcard, Humo, Visa or Mastercard.

scenes.title: Driver app: see the order, then accept
scenes.body: Each order shows the fare, route, distance and payment type, so drivers decide before they accept.

scenes.title: Background GPS on every shift
scenes.body: Metered rides log a GPS point every 5 s while moving, queue points offline and sync them when back online.

scenes.title: Payouts and paperwork
scenes.body: Top up through Payme, withdraw earnings, and upload ID and cabin photos for review — on phone or iPad.
